Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and play with her friends. One day, Lily's mom asked her to help her. Her mom said yes, Lily didn't want to to do. She said to herself.

Lily said, "I can help you to play with her toys. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Lily. We can always behave to make a nice."
